name.zh: WIS 13（战俘／失踪军人纪念公路）

tagline.en: Wisconsin Dells to Superior, with a detour around the Bayfield peninsula
tagline.zh: 自威斯康星戴尔斯至苏必利尔，绕行贝菲尔德半岛

start.en: I-90 and I-94 at Wisconsin Dells
start.zh: 威斯康星戴尔斯的 I-90 与 I-94

end.zh: 苏必利尔的 US 2 与 US 53

en: WIS 13 runs the length of Wisconsin from the tourist strip at Wisconsin Dells to the Lake Superior shore at Superior, and it spends most of that distance as an ordinary two-lane state trunk highway through central Wisconsin farm and forest towns — Junction City, Marshfield, Abbotsford, Prentice.

Then it does something no other Wisconsin route does. At Ashland it joins US 2, leaves it again, and follows the shore of Chequamegon Bay north through Washburn to Bayfield, where the ferry to Madeline Island leaves and the Apostle Islands National Lakeshore begins. At Red Cliff it turns west and traces the Lake Superior shoreline through Cornucopia, Herbster and Port Wing before finally cutting inland to Superior.

That peninsula loop is why the route is long out of proportion to the distance it actually covers, and it is also the part that makes it worth driving: the highway forms part of the Lake Superior Circle Tour from Ashland to its western end.
zh: WIS 13 纵贯威斯康星，自威斯康星戴尔斯的旅游带通至苏必利尔的苏必利尔湖岸；这段路程的大部分时间里，它只是一条普通的双车道州干线，穿过威斯康星中部的农业与林区小镇——章克申城、马什菲尔德、阿伯茨福德、普伦蒂斯。
然后它做了一件威斯康星其他路线都不做的事。在阿什兰，它并入 US 2，随即分离，沿谢奎默根湾岸北行，经沃什伯恩抵达贝菲尔德——前往马德琳岛的渡轮在此启航，使徒群岛国家湖岸也自此开始。在红崖，它折向西，沿苏必利尔湖岸线经科努科皮亚、赫布斯特与波特温，最后才转入内陆前往苏必利尔。
这段半岛环线正是这条路线长度与其实际覆盖距离不成比例的原因，也正是它值得一驶的地方：自阿什兰至西端，该公路是苏必利尔湖环湖游线的一部分。

en: Wisconsin numbered its state trunk highways in 1917, nine years before the United States numbered its own, and the system's original logic was that the lower the number, the longer the route. That rule was abandoned almost immediately as the commission began rearranging the network, but WIS 13 dates from that first system.

The route's formal name is much more recent and comes from the legislature rather than the highway department. Under 1993 Wisconsin Act 396, carried into the statutes as §84.1047, the Department of Transportation was directed to designate WIS 13 from Wisconsin Dells north to Superior as the POW/MIA Memorial Highway.

The statute describes it as a living memorial to and in honour of all prisoners of war, ex-prisoners of war, and those currently or formerly missing in action, in all wars in which the United States has engaged, and requires the department to erect markers at appropriate locations along the route.
zh: 威斯康星于 1917 年为其州干线公路编号，比美国为本国公路编号早了九年；该系统最初的逻辑是编号越小、路线越长。这一规则在委员会开始调整路网后几乎立刻被放弃，但 WIS 13 正出自那第一套系统。
这条路线的正式名称要晚得多，而且来自立法机关而非公路部门。依据 1993 年威斯康星第 396 号法案（编入法典为 §84.1047），交通部被要求将自威斯康星戴尔斯北至苏必利尔的 WIS 13 命名为「战俘／失踪军人纪念公路」。
该法条将其描述为一座活的纪念碑，以纪念并致敬美国参与过的一切战争中的所有战俘、前战俘以及现在或曾经失踪的军人，并要求该部门在沿线适当位置竖立标志。

en: Treat the route as two trips. South of Abbotsford it is a working road — a way of getting between central Wisconsin towns — and it crosses WIS 29, US 10 and US 8 in quick succession as those east–west routes carry the region's through traffic.

North of Ashland it becomes the reason to be there. The Chequamegon Bay shore, the Bayfield ferry dock, the small lakeshore villages west of Red Cliff and the five miles where the highway parallels the Brule River State Forest are the memorable part, and the traffic thins accordingly.

WisDOT's own corridor planning treats the northern half as a combined passenger, freight and tourism route serving the Ashland area and the Bad River Indian Reservation, and its long-term plans for it are mostly about adding bicycle and pedestrian accommodation rather than capacity.
zh: 把这条路线当作两趟旅程来看待。阿伯茨福德以南，它是一条工作用路——在威斯康星中部各城镇之间往来的方式——并接连穿过 WIS 29、US 10 与 US 8，这些东西向路线承担着本地区的过境交通。
阿什兰以北，它本身成了前来的理由。谢奎默根湾岸、贝菲尔德渡口、红崖以西的湖畔小村，以及公路与布鲁尔河州立森林并行的那五英里，是最令人难忘的部分，车流也随之稀疏。
威斯康星交通部自身的走廊规划，把北半段视为服务阿什兰地区与坏河印第安保留地的客运、货运与旅游综合通道，其长期计划主要是增设自行车与步行设施，而非提升通行能力。

value.en: POW/MIA Memorial Highway, Wisconsin Dells to Superior, under 1993 Wisconsin Act 396 (Wis. Stat. §84.1047)
value.zh: 战俘／失踪军人纪念公路，自威斯康星戴尔斯至苏必利尔，依据 1993 年威斯康星第 396 号法案（威州法典 §84.1047）

figures.source: Wisconsin Statutes §84.1047; WisDOT, Commemorative highways and bridges

label.zh: 战俘／失踪军人纪念走廊

value.en: 130 miles, Abbotsford to Ashland, named for the memorial highway designation
value.zh: 130 英里，自阿伯茨福德至阿什兰，因该纪念公路命名而得名

figures.source: WisDOT, Corridors 2030, POW/MIA Remembrance Corridor sheet

why.en: WisDOT's published network route list gives termini but not mileage, and no state-published length for WIS 13 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 威斯康星交通部公布的路网路线清单只给出起终点而无里程；本次未能查证到该州公布的 WIS 13 长度。

timeline.en: WIS 13 is part of Wisconsin's original numbered state trunk highway system, the first in the country.
timeline.zh: WIS 13 属于威斯康星最初的州干线公路编号系统，为全美首创。

timeline.en: The legislature directs WisDOT to designate WIS 13 from Wisconsin Dells to Superior as the POW/MIA Memorial Highway.
timeline.zh: 州议会要求威斯康星交通部将自威斯康星戴尔斯至苏必利尔的 WIS 13 命名为战俘／失踪军人纪念公路。
